parse_method: Flashcard Number blocks with Question, Choices A to D, Correct Answer, and explanation fields

first_card.question: A public school toilet partition wall will be painted and exposed to humidity, occasional splash, and frequent cleaning. Which board substrate is most appropriate?
first_card.correctAnswer: 6mm to 12mm fiber-cement board, HardieFlex/Shera-type, bought per sheet, with treated joints and moisture-compatible paint system

last_card.question: In board exam questions about specifications, testing, submittals, and quality control, what is the best first method to choose the correct answer?
last_card.correctAnswer: Check whether the material is proven by product data, sample, mock-up, method statement, test report, compatibility, delivery condition, storage, inspection, and acceptance criteria
